dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'C' and 'O' shaped structures in the mid-section exhibit dark, irregular perimeters approximately 3-8 pixels thick that transition into lighter, speckled interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, dark, solid-tone punctate clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) distributed primarily across the dorsal and anterior regions, lacking internal color gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli located in the central lateral field form an obtuse scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A light-toned, branched, three-pronged structure is visible as an overlay on the lower posterior region of the animal.
